thread:
marie: Quick sync 1 - customer asked if they can scale down 40% mid-year without penalty. Need final language before we cut price tiers next week.
devon: We should not allow unlimited escapes. Predictability for reserved pools depends on commitments.
anya: Suggest two controls: (1) a one-time 30-day "grace padding" to handle sudden drops, (2) a quarterly shrink cap (25% max reduction) that can be exercised without fee. Anything beyond that triggers a shortfall charge.
samir: Billing options: A) daily measurement + pro-rate committed baseline vs actual, or B) apply a one-time shortfall fee (ETF) computed on the delta. Prefer B for simplicity.
liz: Legal: need an explicit measurement window and an example calculation in the T&Cs. Avoid vague terms like "reasonable". Also include an outage exception (single-cure) and 30-day notice for material changes.
marie: Draft sample calc to include in clause: `shortfall_fee = max(0, committed_units - actual_units_last_30d) * unit_price * 0.25` (25% haircut).
finance-bot: Modeling note: we ran scenarios with haircut 10%, 25%, 50% — 25% balances ARR protection vs churn. Will attach simulation in the roadmap doc.
devon: Ops implications: Console must expose `committed_capacity`, `billing_period_start`, and `next_allowed_shrink_date`. API should prevent updates that exceed allowed shrink cap and return an estimated shortfall.
anya: UX: when a customer requests a reduction show a modal with current_committed, requested_committed, estimated_shortfall_fee, and the sample calc. Link to T&C and show next_allowed_shrink_date.
samir: Launch gating checklist: legal-approved clause + sample calc, finance projections + risk table, billing enforcement flags implemented, UX mock, migration plan for existing pilots. Also backfill script for `next_allowed_shrink_date`.
marie: Action items: Samir to draft clause + examples by Thu EOD; Devon to implement billing flags and API validations; Anya to produce UX mock + copy by Fri; Liz to review clause after Samir finishes. I'll draft pilot migration playbook.
liz: Add requirement that shortfall claims require documented outage evidence for the single-cure exception and that customers give 30 days notice for contract changes.
marie: We'll block the tier cut until legal signoff and add this to the roadmap under "Pricing Controls Q2". Ping me for edge cases. :thumbsup:
